e-attachments.2.evidence: Raw POST of the settings form with jt_attach_types[] svg, svgz, exe appended and csv removed (to prove the request was processed): option became [...txt] without csv and with no svg/svgz/exe. Observation: re-posting a type already in the form (csv twice) stored a duplicate 'csv' in allowed_types (no de-duplication); fixed by saving the form again.

e-attachments.6.evidence: bob POST /jetonomy-pro/v1/attachments with alice's media id -> 403 jetonomy_attach_forbidden 'You can only attach your own uploads.'; after removing txt from allowed types, linking an existing txt upload -> 400 with 'This file type is not allowed. Allowed types: ...'; on a post that already has 5 attachments a sixth -> 400 jetonomy_attach_limit 'You can attach at most 5 files.'. Settings restored.

e-attachments.9.evidence: Guest POST /jetonomy/v1/media and POST /jetonomy-pro/v1/attachments -> 401 rest_not_logged_in; the guest page for a topic with attachments has no attach button (0 data-jt-attach); guest GET /attachments/{link}/download for a public topic's links -> 200 (image/png, text/plain).

e-attachments.1.evidence: Settings > Attachments (tab=attachments): all 12 types ticked, size 8 MB + files 5 saved: notice 'Maximum file size was set to 2 MB, not 8 MB: this server does...' (wp_max_upload_size is 2 MB here) and 'Attachment settings saved.'; stored max_size_bytes 2097152. Clamps: size 0 -> 1 MB, 9999 -> 2 MB (server limit); files 0 -> 1, 99 -> 20. Screenshot att-settings.png.

e-attachments.3.evidence: bob in Help Desk composer: attached 'Dashboard layout.png' (1.2 MB) and 'Community guidelines v3.pdf' (UI, Attach files button), Post Question -> topic shows the image as a thumbnail whose link opens in a new tab (target _blank) and the PDF card 'Community-guidelines-v3.pdf - 3 pages - 1 KB - Open viewer'. Observation: the strip element has no role attribute. Screenshot att-topic.png.

e-attachments.4.evidence: Initial page load requested only the PDF thumbnail; no pdf-viewer.js or pdf.min.mjs. Clicking the PDF card then requested pdf-viewer.js, pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs and the PDF; a role=dialog aria-modal=true box opened with 1 rendered canvas and focus on the box; 8 Tab presses stayed inside the dialog; Escape closed it and focus returned to the PDF card. Overlay-click close not exercised. Screenshot att-pdf-modal.png.

e-attachments.5.evidence: Composer attach: setup.exe -> modal 'That file type is not allowed. Allowed types: JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, TXT, and CSV.'; notes.svg -> same message; a 20 MB PDF -> 'That file is too large. The limit is 2 MB per file.' No chip was created and nothing linked (attachment link rows unchanged). Screenshot att-refuse-exe.png.

e-attachments.7.evidence: Created a post with inline attachment_ids=<id>: 1 row in jt_attachments; then the explicit POST /attachments for the same pair -> 200 and the count stayed 1. Linking the same pair twice via REST also returned 200 both times with one row.

e-attachments.8.evidence: Attached the PDF to a reply (id 3967) of the 52-reply topic 'Dark mode for the community on phones' in Feature Requests: on 'Load More' (page 2 of replies) a .jt-attach-strip renders on that reply with the PDF card. NOT measured: whether attachments load in a batch without one query per row (no query log access on this stack).

e-attachments.10.evidence: Admin attached a file to the Customer Advisory Board topic 3262: bob, test_moderator and a guest GET .../attachments/7/download -> 404; priya (member of that space) -> 200 with the content; GET /posts/3262 as bob -> 404 jetonomy_not_found, for priya the post lists the attachment with a download-route URL. SECURITY NOTE: the file's direct URL returned by the upload (.../wp-content/uploads/jetonomy/<16-hex dir>/cab.txt) returns 200 to a guest, i.e. protection depends on that directory name staying secret; the PDF viewer also loads the file from that direct uploads URL. Cleaned up.

e-attachments.11.evidence: bob DELETE of his post (id 5424 with a linked file) -> status trash, 1 link row and the media post remain. Admin DELETE ?force=true -> deleted permanent, link rows 0, media post still present (left for the media sweep). (?permanent=true is not the parameter; the first attempt returned 409 'moderator can restore it or delete it permanently'.)

e-attachments.12.evidence: Seeded unlinked media: own upload tagged _jetonomy_media_origin=upload aged 48 h, own upload aged 2 h, a subscriber-authored attachment tagged only _jetonomy_media aged 48 h, plus a link row pointing at attachment 999999. Ran the jetonomy_cleanup_media action: the 48 h own upload was deleted, the 2 h one survived, the foreign-tagged one survived, the orphan link row was removed. Seeds removed.

Screenshot att-long-390.png.

e-attachments.14.evidence: Topic with 5 attachments (image, PDF, 3 text) at 390px: the strip stacks the five cards at full column width (32-358 px), scrollWidth 390, no overflow (att-five-390.png). The sixth is refused by the API with 400 jetonomy_attach_limit 'You can attach at most 5 files.' (UI refusal message for a sixth not exercised).
